title: 墨菲特·小石头伙伴
description: 巨大岩石墨菲特蹲在地面，轻轻摆好一座小石头人，层叠石甲和小脑袋保持鲜明。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Malphite is a huge living rock elemental with a small angular head set between enormous layered stone shoulders, thick blocky arms, and short powerful legs. Preserve his jagged mountain-like silhouette and earthy green-brown rock plates, but round the crayon edges and give him kind little eyes. He is entirely stone rather than a clothed human, with no cracking destruction or frightening lava effects.
art_direction.scene: He crouches beside a tiny stack of smooth pebbles and gently adds one round stone to make a miniature companion. One huge open palm steadies the ground beside the stack without crushing anything. A little tuft of grass and a soft hill shape emphasize scale, and his entire broad body fits within the square.
art_direction.palette: earth brown, moss green, warm gray, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
